note.en: A coastal schooling anchovy that tolerates brackish water, known from Big Bite Bay, Bocas del Toro (2008), with no specimen found inside the region.
note.es: Una anchoa costera de cardumen que tolera agua salobre, conocida de Big Bite Bay, Bocas del Toro (2008), sin espécimen hallado dentro de la región.

evidence: GBIF: one 2008 ROM specimen from Bocas del Toro
FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the western Caribbean
